meaning: Initialize the local global-applet-loaded flag for second-stage entry after ABL, avoiding repeated cold initialization of global secure apps.
evidence: TB520FU load/start wrappers at 0x2FA4 and 0x3304 read 0xE5A8, call LoadSecureApps 0x31A0 if clear, then set the flag. Corresponding Onyx wrappers use 0xF5B0; its patch changes that byte from 0 to 1.
limitations: Onyx is a different SoC; its address is not copied. This preserves the ABL handoff assumption and does not repair the secure-world ABI or support arbitrary new TA loads.
